### Fixed
- **`kubectl logs` shows muster's log when an OTLP endpoint is set.** In OTLP mode mcp-toolkit's logging replaced the console handler, so muster wrote nothing to stdout or stderr, and with the collector down its log went nowhere. `muster serve` now passes mcp-toolkit's `WithStderrMirror` in OTLP mode: every record also goes to stderr as JSON with `trace_id` and `span_id`. `--silent` still writes nothing to the console. ([giantswarm/giantswarm#36711](https://github.com/giantswarm/giantswarm/issues/36711))
